transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I came in because things that usually keep me feeling like myself just don’t really feel that way lately. Like going out for photography walks, helping mentor the kids, even just keeping my calendar together. It all started feeling kind of flat and heavy, and I stopped starting things.
Have you noticed that activities you usually enjoy, like your photography walks or mentoring the kids, feel less interesting or pleasurable to you lately?

Yeah… I guess that’s pretty much it. The photography walks and mentoring used to feel like mine, you know? Lately they just feel kind of flat. Heavy. Even keeping my calendar clean, which I usually care about, I just… don’t really start.
Have you been feeling more tired or low on energy lately, even when you’re not doing much?
I don’t know… not really in a clear way. I haven’t been doing much, so it’s hard to tell. Maybe a little worn down, but I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed it that strongly.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to focus, make decisions, or think clearly lately?

A little, yeah. Work is still… mostly fine, but I’ve been missing small calendar details and double-checking things I used to just do automatically. And outside of work I’ve kind of pulled back from photography and mentoring, because I don’t feel as present or reliable.
Have you felt down, sad, or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
I don’t know if I’d call it depressed most of the day. I’ve been kind of flat, I guess… but I haven’t really tracked it like that.
Have you felt down or low most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I could say it’s been most of the day, nearly every day… not in a clear way. It’s been kind of hard to pin down.
Over the past two weeks, have you had days where you felt down or low for most of the day?
Maybe a few, but I’m not really sure it was most of the day. It kind of comes and goes, and I haven’t been keeping track that closely.

Over the past two weeks, have you felt a loss of interest or pleasure in activities like your photography walks or mentoring the kids, where it felt like you just couldn’t get into them or enjoy them the way you used to?

Yeah… kind of. Those things usually help me feel like myself, but lately they’ve just felt flat. Like the photography walks, mentoring, even keeping my calendar together… it all feels heavier, and I’ve been not really starting them.
Looking back over the past two weeks, would you say there were several days where you felt down or low for most of the day, not just off and on?
I don’t really know. Maybe some days felt heavier than others, but “most of the day” is hard for me to say. I wasn’t really measuring it like that.
Over the past two weeks, would you say that on most days, you felt down or low for most of the day, not just occasionally?
I’m not sure I’d say most days, no. Some days were low, but it wasn’t something I tracked closely.
Over the past two weeks, have you had days where you felt down or low for most of the day, nearly every day, not just off and on?
I don’t think I can say “nearly every day.” There were low stretches, yeah, but I’m not sure it was most of the day like that.
Over the past two weeks, was there a period of several consecutive days where you felt down or low for most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I can think of a few rough days, but whether they were consecutive and most of the day… I don’t know.

Over the past two weeks, have you experienced days where you completely lost interest in your photography walks, mentoring, or other activities you used to enjoy, where it felt impossible to get any pleasure from them at all?

Yeah… I guess that’s part of why I came in. The photography walks and mentoring, even just keeping my calendar together, started feeling kind of flat. Heavy. I haven’t really been starting them like I normally would.
Have you noticed yourself doing or starting less of your usual activities, like photography walks, mentoring, or keeping your calendar, because you’ve felt less motivated or interested?
Yeah… that’s been happening. Those things usually make me feel like myself, but lately they’ve felt flat, kind of heavy. I just haven’t been starting them the way I normally would.
Can you think of any two-week period in the past few months where you felt down or low most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t know. I can’t really pin it down as a full two weeks like that. There’ve been low stretches, I guess, but… I’m not sure they were most of the day nearly every day.

Can you recall if there was a two-week period in the past few months where you completely lost interest in photography walks, mentoring, or other activities you used to enjoy, where it felt impossible to get any pleasure from them at all?

Yeah… I mean, that’s kind of what made me come in. The walks, mentoring, even keeping my calendar clean… they just started feeling flat. Heavy. I wasn’t really getting anything from them, so I stopped starting them.

Can you recall if there was a specific two-week period in the past few months where you completely stopped getting any enjoyment from your photography walks, mentoring, or other activities you used to care about?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t know the exact dates, but there was a stretch where those things just felt… flat. The walks, mentoring the kids, even keeping my calendar together. I wasn’t getting much out of them, so I just stopped starting them.

Can you recall if there was a specific period lasting at least two weeks where you felt a complete loss of interest or pleasure in your photography walks, mentoring, or other activities you used to care about, almost every day for most of the day?

Yeah… I think it was at least a couple weeks. The stuff that usually makes me feel like myself—the photo walks, mentoring, keeping my calendar straight—it all just felt flat. Heavy, I guess. I wasn’t getting anything from it, so I stopped initiating it.

Can you confirm if there was a specific two-week period where you felt a complete loss of interest or pleasure in your photography walks, mentoring, or other activities you used to care about, nearly every day for most of the day?

Yeah… yes. That’s what made me come in, really. For a couple weeks or more, the things that usually make me feel like myself—photo walks, mentoring the kids, keeping my calendar clean—just felt flat and heavy. I wasn’t getting anything from them, so I stopped starting them.
